I replied to Tobias in his thread in #central-random. I said I'd noted that the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats, and suggested he also correct his earlier post in #central-team, since it still shows the wrong number to anyone who read it.

He said no action was needed, so I did nothing else. I didn't open #central-team and didn't repeat his old number. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so the reply didn't need approval.
